scope: Post-comparison retrieval maintenance: conservative English negative-list removal from search text, positive source-anchor gating, no zero-score/category padding, and honest no-evidence UI without a model call. Raw patient data, model settings, source corpus and original experiment evidence are unchanged.
limitations: Limited English heuristic, not comprehensive NER/negation or a diagnostic probability.
Positive source symptom anchors are necessary for retrieval consideration, not sufficient for diagnosis or treatment eligibility.
No calibrated BM25 threshold, independent clinical validation or new 12-call comparison is claimed.
